output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds arbitrary amount of tokens to target's balance and increases the total supply. This can be exploited to achieve loss of token.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds arbitrary amount of tokens to _to's balance and decreases _from's balance without overflow check. This can be exploited to achieve token loss.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It allows the owner to set the allowance of spender to a negative value, causing buy function to revert.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It allows the owner to burn arbitrary amount of tokens from target, causing target's balance to become negative.
